en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large historic church dominating a cobbled town square. The building has a tall central tower with a baroque onion-shaped dome topped by a slender spire and cross. The lower tower and west front are in a more Romanesque/early Gothic style with small arched windows and a decorative roundel, while the long nave to the right has pronounced Gothic buttresses and pinnacles. A few small figures stand on the square, and plain multi‑storey townhouses frame the background.
